verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is an admin-docs page titled 'manage-sharing'. It confirms that external sharing in SharePoint/OneDrive is a managed feature, but the quoted text only says users can share outside the organization. It does not describe any org-level controls over who may share externally. The createLink API is a user/app sharing action, not an admin governance control. Missing for 10: documented tenant-level controls restricting who can share externally, domain allowlist/blocklist settings, link-type or expiration restrictions, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
